AGENDA

340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48
hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, October 28, 2014.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that
are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2,
the Parklands Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any
item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency
nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  OCTOBER 13, 2014

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  October 13, 2014
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, October 28, 2014.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Peterson, Rubincam and Kaviani

  Members absent: Chooljian and Wade

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Norman E. Witt expressed concern about a tree that grows adjacent to the street that has
roots under the pavement.

CITIZEN APPLICATION

1.  PC-385-14; Application to remove 2 Casurina trees located in the parkway
  adjacent to 3717 Via Palomino

  Applicant:  Shane Andrews
  3717 Via Palomino
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

The applicant requested this item be continued.

2.  PC-386-14: Application to remove 4 Casurina trees located in the parkway
  adjacent to 3417 Via Palomino

  Applicant:  Gordon Curtis
  142 Rivo Alto Canal Naples Island
  Long Beach, CA 90803

Action: Committee member Kaviani moved and Rubincam seconded to continue
this application. The vote was 3-0, Chooljian & Wade absent.
 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, October 28, 2014.
  Directors initials SR-L
 3.  PC-387-14; Application to remove 4 Pepper trees located in the parkway adjacent
  to 641-649 Via Del Monte

  Applicant:  Jeff Dollinger
  700 Via Somonte
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Kaviani moved and Rubincam seconded to continue
this application. The vote was 3-0, Chooljian & Wade absent.

4.  PC-388-14; Application to remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway
  adjacent to 2325 Via Acalones

  Applicant:  Diana Gdowski
  2320 Via Acalones
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Rubincam moved and Kaviani seconded to approve for
removal 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2320 Via Acalones
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. A $500
payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ is required. The vote was 3-0, Chooljian & Wade
absent.

5.  PC-389-14; Application to remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent
  to 1617 Via Arriba

  Applicant:  Anne and Allegra Danna
  1617 Via Arriba
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Rubincam moved and Kaviani seconded to approve the
removal of 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1617 Via Arriba
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. A $500
payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ is required. The vote was 2-1, Peterson dissenting,
Chooljian & Wade absent.

OLD BUSINESS

6.  Review of the landscape at the Entrance from Rancho Palos Verdes at Granvia
  Altamira

Action: Committee member Kaviani moved and Rubincam seconded to approve the
Pink Trumpet tree and proposed landscaping for the center median at the entrance
from Rancho Palos Verdes at Granvia Altamira. The vote was 3-0, Chooljian &
Wade absent.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, October 28, 2014.
  Directors initials SR-L
 7.  Discussion of Bluff Cove homes project

A site inspection is scheduled for the afternoon of Monday the 20th of October.

NEW BUSINESS

8.  Joint meeting with City Council – Received & filed.

9.  Parklands Committee meeting day change

Committee requested no change until after January 2015.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

10.  Update on 2014 applications – Received & filed.

ADJOURNMENT

Adjourned to November 10, 2014

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, October 28, 2014.
  Directors initials SR-L
